title: Nexus: An Agentic Framework for Time Series Forecasting

claim.summary: Nexus structures chronological multimodal context, combines macro/micro forecast agents, and validates learned calibration guidelines on held-out historical folds.

modules.name: Value-linked chronological context
modules.scope_reason: The preprocessing aligns each observed value with its contemporaneous textual driving factors; no predicted horizon is required by this representation.

modules.name: Macro/micro forecast synthesis
modules.scope_reason: Separate forecasts for broad trajectory and per-step catalysts are synthesized over a specified horizon.
evidence_locators: PDF p.4; 3.2 Dual-Resolution Forecast Outlook Generation

modules.name: Validated backtest critique guidelines
modules.scope_reason: Critiques are formed from sequential forecast errors and gated by hidden-fold improvement.
evidence_locators: PDF p.5; 3.3 Forecast Synthesis and Calibration
